description: Thermostat temperatures of one run as 30 s block means, written by reduce_runs.py. Time is the run clock: zero at the start of the temperature program.
range_basis: The temperature program runs between 293.15 and 318.15 K. A value outside 273.15 to 373.15 K is taken as a corrupted row; the limits are a plausibility check, not a property of the solvent.
